title: Once-only proactive placement enforcement
goal: Explore a longer food-ordering conversation with repeated opportunities for assistance after proactive placements have already been consumed.
preconditions: Use a fresh D1 session with the deterministic synthetic customer authority demo-qualification-08-once-only and continue the conversation after proactive recommendation placements are consumed.
No session or order-flow state is reset during the attempt.
The role-player may accept or decline observed offers according to the evolving customer intent.

turns.speaker: User
turns.text: Mình sẽ hỏi thêm vài điều về đơn sau khi đã chọn món, cứ hỗ trợ tự nhiên nhé.

risks: Repeated conversational turns must not reset or replay proactive placements.
An absence claim requires durable state and event evidence, not transcript wording alone.
